Reinforcement learning has recently emerged as a pivotal technique for augmenting LLM reasoning, demonstrating broad success ranging from traditional mathematical and code generation tasks (Guo et al. , 2025 ; Wang et al. , 2025a ) to intricate multi-modal challenges (Huang et al. , 2025c ; Wang et al. , 2025b ; Li et al. , 2025b ) and structured data environments (Shi et al. , 2025 ; Tang et al. , 2025 ) . To support these diverse applications and enable complex behaviors like RelayLLM , concurrent research is actively refining methodologies through novel training paradigms, such as self-play (Liu et al. , 2025 ; Huang et al. , 2025b ; Yu et al. , 2025b ) , alongside developing more robust algorithmic techniques exemplified by DAPO (Yu et al. , 2025a ) , VAPO (Yue et al. , 2025 ) , and high-entropy guided optimization (Dai et al. , 2025 ; Wang et al. , 2025d ; Zhou et al. , 2025 ) .
